steer.use: wall/fort slide, heading damp, pincer offset, intercept

flow.use: potential field: attract prey, repel fear, ridge off walls/forts

roles.use: SCREEN / BAIT / STRIKE / ESCORT from local fear vs prey

form.use: wedge / line / ring slots about the pack centroid

orbit.use: tangent stand-off around prey or a fort

pressure.use: local friend/fear/prey density; give ground, slide off blobs, hunt sparse prey

lanes.use: split hunters into parallel corridors so CLEAR_HUNT does not stack one gap

intercept.use: lead pursuit and chord-cut of a circling target (anti-orbit)

desync.use: stable per-unit heading fan so mirrored cards do not share one path

prey_repel.desc: soft radial away from last 2-3 prey while predators live

orbit_herd.desc: tangential herd around last meals; contact still converts

fort_cover.desc: put fort between self and fear

no_corner_herd.desc: don't pin last prey in a corner

bounce_reset.desc: use wall bounce as an evade heading reset

lane_sweep.desc: each hunter owns a parallel corridor

clock_eta.desc: steer by time-to-contact, not raw bearing

mark_role.desc: 1-1 mark so two units do not chase the same prey

lead_intercept.desc: chase where prey will be, not where it is

chord_cut.desc: cut the chord of an orbiting prey

desync_fan.desc: fan headings so mirrored cards do not clone one path

BAIT_TURN.title: Bait turn
BAIT_TURN.desc: Assign one BAIT to peel around a fort; STRIKE hits the opened flank.

BOUNCE_JUKE.title: Bounce juke
BOUNCE_JUKE.desc: Use wall/fort bounce (phys) as a heading reset the hunter cannot track. Cut tangent after impact.

CHOKE_PINCH.title: Choke pinch
CHOKE_PINCH.desc: Contested with forts: pin prey against a fort/wall pair, pincer from both gaps.

CHORD_CUT.title: Chord cut
CHORD_CUT.desc: Cut the chord of a circling prey. Counter to ORBIT_KITE mirrors that otherwise never close.

CLEAR_FAN.title: Clear fan
CLEAR_FAN.desc: No predators: fan into a wedge + time-to-intercept so leftover prey are taken in parallel, not one-by-one.

CLEAR_SPLIT.title: Clear split
CLEAR_SPLIT.desc: No predators left: Voronoi split + give ground so packs do not stack on one prey.

CLOSE_QUARTERS.title: Close quarters
CLOSE_QUARTERS.desc: Spatial-hash melee: local pack is tight. Separate, intercept, take the nearest prey only.

CONTESTED_SPLIT.title: Contested split
CONTESTED_SPLIT.desc: Fear still lives: Voronoi the current prey so the pack does not all crash the same contact while predators roam.

CROSS_LANE.title: Cross lane
CROSS_LANE.desc: Cut perpendicular to a lane-sweep. Counter when the other team owns LANE_SWEEP.

DELAY_FEAST.title: Delay feast
DELAY_FEAST.desc: Last prey still lives and predators live: do not convert. Orbit and peel until fear is gone.

DENSITY_RAID.title: Density raid
DENSITY_RAID.desc: Small unit: hunt the sparsest prey, ignore the blob.

ESCORT_RING.title: Escort ring
ESCORT_RING.desc: Last few allies: ring formation, orbit the pack, body-block fear.

ETA_SPLIT.title: ETA split
ETA_SPLIT.desc: CLEAR_HUNT: assign hunters by time-to-intercept, not nearest, so wall prey get a closer hunter.

ETA_STRIKE.title: ETA strike
ETA_STRIKE.desc: Hunt only when convert-before-fear is true; otherwise peel. Two-wave feast.

FEAR_RIDGE.title: Fear ridge
FEAR_RIDGE.desc: No prey, fear alive: ride the low-density ridge between predator blobs and walls.

FINISH_CLOCK.title: Finish clock
FINISH_CLOCK.desc: Predators in a clean endgame: minimise time-to-contact on assigned prey. Opposite of LAST_MAN_CLOCK.

FORT_KITE.title: Fort kite
FORT_KITE.desc: Outnumbered but prey still lives: drag predators around forts, take shots only when cover is clean.

GATE_CAMP.title: Gate camp
GATE_CAMP.desc: Park in the alley between two forts. Flow funnels prey into the gap; pincer the exit.

GIVE_GROUND.title: Give ground
GIVE_GROUND.desc: Contested overcrowding: slide off own density into prey gaps.

LANE_SWEEP.title: Lane sweep
LANE_SWEEP.desc: Split hunters across parallel corridors (new lanes math) so packs stop jamming one fort gap in CLEAR_HUNT.

LAST_MAN_CLOCK.title: Last man clock
LAST_MAN_CLOCK.desc: Last unit alive: steer by time-to-contact. Maximise hunter ETA; take cover only if it lengthens the clock.

LAST_MAN_RUN.title: Last man run
LAST_MAN_RUN.desc: Exactly one left and predators live: maximise time-to-death. Cover, kite, bounce, never cluster.

LAST_MEAL_ORBIT.title: Last meal orbit
LAST_MEAL_ORBIT.desc: Last 3/2/1 of our prey while our predator lives: tangent orbit, peel off contact. Convert is legal on touch — don't touch.

LAST_MEAL_STALL.title: Last meal stall
LAST_MEAL_STALL.desc: You are the food: maximize time-to-death. Orbit walls/forts, bounce-juke, never line up on the hunter.

LAST_PREY_CARE.title: Last prey care
LAST_PREY_CARE.desc: 3/2/1 prey left and our predator lives: flee fear and peel off the meals. Convert is legal; touching them is a losing move.

LAST_STAND.title: Last stand
LAST_STAND.desc: About to wipe: survive, don't cluster

MARK_ONE.title: Mark one
MARK_ONE.desc: Contested: role-assign 1-1 marks so two allies do not collapse on the same prey while another walks free.

MIRROR_BREAK.title: Mirror break
MIRROR_BREAK.desc: Fan headings when both sides lock the same card (LANE_SWEEP vs LANE_SWEEP). Stops cloned trajectories.

NASH_HOLD.title: Nash hold
NASH_HOLD.desc: Winning too hard locks a hierarchy (pure Nash). Ease off: give ground, escort, stop the last conversion while fear lives.

OPEN_KITE.title: Open kite
OPEN_KITE.desc: Outnumbered in open space: circle, slide walls, take only intercept shots. No fort required.

ORBIT_KITE.title: Orbit kite
ORBIT_KITE.desc: Circle prey or a fort on a tangent ring; take shots only when ETA is safe.

PACK_HUNT.title: Pack hunt
PACK_HUNT.desc: Outnumber prey: pack and collapse a chosen target

PAIR_LOCK.title: Pair lock
PAIR_LOCK.desc: CLEAR_HUNT: two hunters per prey via Voronoi + lead intercept. Cuts pile-on endgames.

PRESSURE_BREAK.title: Pressure break
PRESSURE_BREAK.desc: Last-prey / outnumbered: peel off fear blobs and refuse corner piles.

REGROUP_RIDGE.title: Regroup ridge
REGROUP_RIDGE.desc: Dispersed team: flow along the pressure ridge between forts/walls, then re-form. Fills the thin REGROUP book.

ROLE_SWEEP.title: Role sweep
ROLE_SWEEP.desc: Assign SCREEN/BAIT/STRIKE, hold a wedge, flow onto prey.

SCATTER_RAID.title: Scatter raid
SCATTER_RAID.desc: Few of us: spread and eat isolated prey

SCREEN_HUNT.title: Screen hunt
SCREEN_HUNT.desc: Assign SCREEN units to face fear; STRIKE takes isolated prey.

SHADOW_PREY.title: Shadow prey
SHADOW_PREY.desc: Fear alive: hide inside the prey flock so predators must risk hitting their food.

STALL_BREAK.title: Stall break
STALL_BREAK.desc: Predator answer to LAST_MEAL_STALL: lead intercept + ETA gate so a kiting last group cannot run the clock.

SURVIVE_FEAR.title: Survive fear
SURVIVE_FEAR.desc: Prey gone, predators live: slide off fear blobs, orbit cover, delay the loss.

WALL_CUTOFF.title: Wall cutoff
WALL_CUTOFF.desc: CLEAR_HUNT: intercept prey sliding a wall instead of chasing their current heading.

WALL_POUNCE.title: Wall pounce
WALL_POUNCE.desc: Slide a wall or fort, then cut back onto prey on the rebound.
